title: Astro Portal API v1 — the owner's equipment
description: « Mon espace » → « Matériel » (packages/portal/src/equipment/manage-equipment.js; packages/portal-app/src/routes/api/v1/manage/equipment/). GET /v1/manage/equipment (a web session, or a paired device) answers `read`; POST answers `item` (201) — and so does POST /v1/equipment, the same body `{ equipment }` sent by a paired device allowed to write; PATCH /v1/manage/equipment answers `read` (`importRead` for an import); PATCH and DELETE /v1/manage/equipment/{id} answer `item`. Writes take a web session with its CSRF token, or a paired device's bearer (never the restore of an archived item: `web_session_required`); a device's write is refused `403` `entitlement_read_only` in the read-only window of an ended subscription. GET and PUT /v1/manage/default-configuration (« Ma configuration par défaut ») answer `configurationRead`; PUT takes `configurationWrite`, with the same credentials as the other writes. Refusals use the v1 error envelope: `invalid_request` (400), `invalid_equipment_order` (400), `equipment_not_found` (404: a default row or another space's item is unknown here), `web_session_required` (403), `entitlement_read_only` (403), `equipment_storage_unavailable` (503).

equipment.description: The space's own items, archived ones included (`archivedAt`), by kind then preference order.

defaultConfiguration.description: « Ma configuration par défaut » of the space; null when none is set. Additive: a portal older than it sends none.

equipmentInput.description: The item a POST or a PATCH carries (`{ equipment }`). Its `id`, if any, is never used: POST always makes a new item, PATCH edits the item of the path.

planner.description: What the planners read of the item. Additive fields: on a filter `equipmentIds` (the ids of the telescopes and cameras it is attached to) and `forAllEquipment` (offered for all equipment, the default true; false limits it to `equipmentIds`); on a telescope or a camera `ownFiltersOnly` (offer only the filters attached to it, default false, true for a telescope made from a smart-telescope profile); on a telescope `profileId` (the id of the common profile it was made from, which names its built-in filters); on a telescope `finder` (`aligned`: its finder is aligned with the tube; `none`: no finder; absent: not said — what the phone's axis calibration asks first).

importRead.description: The answer of `{ action: "import", items }`: the read, and one entry per item sent, in order.

equipment.description: The space's own items, archived ones included (`archivedAt`), by kind then preference order.

defaultConfiguration.description: « Ma configuration par défaut » of the space; null when none is set. Additive: a portal older than it sends none.

localId.description: The phone's own identifier of the item, null when it sent none (or one that is not 1–100 of A–Z, a–z, 0–9, _ and -).

id.description: The item of the space it is now.

created.description: False when the space already held it (same identifier, or same kind, name and characteristics).

configurationRead.description: GET or PUT /v1/manage/default-configuration: the configuration of the space (null: none) and the time of its last write (null: never written).

configurationWrite.description: PUT /v1/manage/default-configuration: the configuration that replaces the space's (an object; its other keys are dropped), or null to set none. A plan's own equipment never writes it.
